key_correction: A real capability may be implemented by a system of models, programs, tools, memory, and verification. It does not need to reside inside one model or one worker identity before it counts as useful capability.
laws: use strongest existing component for each subproblem
verification follows execution and never substitutes for it
integrate only where integration itself is required by real work
scale only after capability strength is useful

capability_lanes.target: Operate websites and software to complete real goals, including unfamiliar interfaces and correction.
capability_lanes.current_gap: arbitrary Windows GUI interaction remains incomplete; web interaction should not wait for it

capability_lanes.target: Understand unfamiliar codebases, research dependencies, implement changes, run/test/debug/deploy.
capability_lanes.current_gap: strength must be grown through hard real repositories, not predicate tests

capability_lanes.target: Acquire unknown knowledge, compare sources, reason over evidence, preserve provenance.
capability_lanes.current_gap: bind research directly into execution loops

capability_lanes.target: Produce and edit useful documents, spreadsheets, presentations, designs, and structured work products.
Solve difficult mathematical, scientific, technical, and analytical problems with tools and verification.
capability_lanes.current_gap: measure only when a real problem exposes a weakness

capability_lanes.target: Preserve mission, evidence, decisions, and unfinished work across chats, failures, and tool boundaries.
capability_lanes.current_gap: make continuity routine, not a promotion gate

capability_lanes.target: Select tools/routes, decompose work, run independent lanes, verify, reconcile, and continue with minimal user intervention.
capability_lanes.current_gap: apply to capability missions rather than infrastructure chores

execution_method.step_1: Choose the highest-value real mission that forces multiple target capabilities.
execution_method.step_2: Decompose only where parallelism reduces wall-clock time.
execution_method.step_3: For every subtask, search existing tools/services/code before building.
execution_method.step_4: Use the strongest existing route for that subtask, even if different routes use different models/programs.
execution_method.step_5: Integrate outputs through canonical Brain state and evidence.
execution_method.step_6: Inspect the actual result and repair observed weaknesses.
execution_method.step_7: When a repeated capability weakness appears, improve that capability component directly.
execution_method.step_8: Repeat on substantially different real missions until capability is robust.
execution_method.step_9: Only then package/replicate into autonomous workers and scale.
